description:
BOTH ROOMS DOUBLES · TWO SHOWER ROOMS · LOCATED ON NORTHUMBERLAND STREET

My Property Box are delighted to offer for rent this two double bedrooms student property on Northumberland Street located directly opposite Fenwicks Department Store, just moments away from the universities. The property is superbly located on one of the UK's prestige shopping streets and offers access to countless local shops, bars and amenities in Newcastle City Centre and the Quayside. Northumberland Street is close to bus, metro and rail links into other areas. The property is well presented and accommodation comprises; communal entrance with with security video entry & private mail boxes, reception hallway, lounge, kitchen, two bedrooms (one with En Suite as well as the main Bathroom. The property is quadruple Glazed. Kitchen has dishwasher, washer/ dryer, electric hob and oven, electric heating. Bathroom has shower over bath and master bedroom with en suite shower room. Pre Wired for SKY, neutrally decorated and modern interior. To arrange a viewing please call My Property Box today 0191 212 0400.
